FINAL AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT — COMPLETE FULL PRODUCTION CHAIN NOW

The audit phase is complete.

The remaining objective is not another report.

The objective is to make IVX autonomous deployment fully operational outside the Rork workflow.

GOAL

Complete this chain end to end:

OWNER APPROVAL
→ IVX AUTONOMOUS WORKER
→ CODE CHECKOUT
→ TESTS
→ BUILD
→ COMMIT/PUSH
→ RENDER DEPLOYMENT
→ HEALTH CHECK
→ VERSION MATCH
→ PROOF LEDGER
→ ROLLBACK READY

Do not stop after code changes.
Do not stop after tests.
Do not stop after deployment.
Do not return another plan without execution evidence.

==================================================
1. USE THE IVX REPOSITORY
==================================================

Primary repository:

ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Verify:

- Repository owner: ibb142
- Default branch: main
- Current GitHub HEAD SHA
- All required branches and tags are intact
- Render API and worker services are linked to this repository
- No production deployment uses the old repository name
- No production source exists only inside the Rork sandbox

Return evidence.

==================================================
2. USE IVX-CONTROLLED CI
==================================================

Verify and activate the real workflows:

- .github/workflows/ivx-ci.yml
- .github/workflows/build-apk-release.yml
- Any IVX-controlled deployment workflow

Move any valid workflow currently stored outside `.github/workflows/` into the correct GitHub Actions location after verifying syntax and permissions.

The primary pipeline must run:

1. Checkout
2. Dependency install
3. Lint
4. Type check
5. Unit tests
6. Integration tests
7. Security scan
8. Backend build
9. Worker build
10. Website build
11. Artifact generation
12. Deployment authorization check
13. Render deployment
14. Health verification
15. Version verification
16. Proof ledger update

No workflow may require a Rork login, token, SDK, or runtime.

==================================================
3. COMPLETE OWNER AUTHORIZATION
==================================================

Use the owner authorization flow already implemented.

The production flow must be:

Owner signs into IVX
→ current Supabase session is validated
→ owner authorizes exact action and exact commit
→ short-lived single-use worker access is generated
→ only token hash is stored
→ worker consumes it once
→ replay is rejected

Do not use a permanent Supabase user token in Render.

Do not ask the owner to paste a token into Rork chat.

Add or finish the owner-only control:

AUTHORIZE AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT

Required fields:

- Action
- Commit SHA
- Worker ID
- Expiration
- Environment
- Deployment scope

Expected statuses:

- Valid owner: HTTP 201
- Missing session: HTTP 401
- Invalid/expired session: HTTP 401
- Non-owner: HTTP 403

==================================================
4. VERIFY THE AUTONOMOUS WORKER
==================================================

Worker:

ivx-senior-dev-01

Verify:

- Worker service ID
- Worker deployment ID
- Worker live SHA
- Worker heartbeat
- AI provider credential loaded
- GitHub credential loaded
- Render credential loaded
- Supabase credential loaded
- HMAC worker identity loaded
- Queue connection healthy
- Proof ledger connection healthy

Return credential names and PRESENT/MISSING only.

Never reveal values.

==================================================
5. CREATE ONE REAL DEPLOYMENT JOB
==================================================

Create one owner-approved production deployment job.

The job must be bound to:

- Exact GitHub repository
- Exact branch
- Exact commit SHA
- Exact worker ID
- Exact deployment action
- Short expiration
- Single use

Required states:

- approval_created
- authorization_issued
- job_queued
- worker_authenticated
- authorization_consumed
- checkout_started
- tests_running
- build_running
- deployment_started
- deployment_live
- health_verified
- version_verified
- proof_written
- job_completed

==================================================
6. RUN THE FULL PRE-DEPLOYMENT GATE
==================================================

Before deployment, run:

- Dependency installation
- Lint
- TypeScript check
- Unit tests
- Integration tests
- Worker authorization tests
- Replay-rejection test
- Security scan
- Secret scan
- Rork dependency guard
- Backend build
- Worker build
- Website build

Do not deploy if any critical test fails.

Return:

- Command
- Exit code
- Passed/failed count
- Duration
- Artifact or log reference

==================================================
7. DEPLOY THE EXACT APPROVED COMMIT
==================================================

Deploy the exact approved SHA to the existing services.

Do not create a new repository.
Do not create a new Render service.
Do not deploy an older commit.
Do not manually substitute another SHA.

Deploy:

- IVX API
- IVX autonomous worker
- Website if the approved commit changes it

Return:

- GitHub HEAD SHA
- Approved SHA
- API deployment ID
- Worker deployment ID
- Website deployment ID
- API live SHA
- Worker live SHA
- Website live version
- Deployment timestamps

All SHAs must match the approved commit where applicable.

==================================================
8. VERIFY LIVE PRODUCTION
==================================================

Run live checks:

WEBSITE
- https://ivxholding.com
- /robots.txt
- /sitemap.xml

API
- /health
- /version

CHAT
- Normal public request
- Protected deployment request

OWNER
- Owner endpoint with no token
- Owner endpoint with valid owner session

WORKER
- Worker status
- Worker heartbeat
- Latest job
- Queue depth

Expected:

- Website HTTP 200
- /health HTTP 200
- /version HTTP 200
- /version SHA matches GitHub HEAD
- Public chat HTTP 200
- Protected request blocked safely
- Missing owner auth returns 401
- Valid owner request succeeds
- Worker heartbeat healthy
- Job status completed

==================================================
9. PROVE SINGLE-USE AUTHORIZATION
==================================================

After successful consumption:

- Attempt to reuse the same worker authorization.
- Reject the replay.
- Confirm no duplicate deployment job is created.
- Confirm no second production deployment begins.

Return:

- Replay attempt timestamp
- HTTP status
- Structured error code
- Duplicate job count
- Duplicate deployment count

Expected:

Replay rejected = YES
Duplicate job = NO
Duplicate deployment = NO

==================================================
10. WRITE THE PROOF LEDGER
==================================================

The proof ledger must record:

- Owner authorization ID
- Owner ID or masked owner identifier
- Job ID
- Worker ID
- Repository
- Branch
- Approved SHA
- Executed SHA
- Test result
- Build result
- Deployment IDs
- Live SHAs
- Health response
- Version response
- Replay rejection
- Completion timestamp
- Final status

The ledger entry must survive service restart.

==================================================
11. VERIFY RESTART AND RECOVERY
==================================================

After completion:

- Restart or redeploy the worker safely.
- Confirm the completed job remains completed.
- Confirm the proof ledger remains available.
- Confirm the consumed authorization remains unusable.
- Confirm the worker heartbeat returns.
- Confirm no duplicate execution occurs.

==================================================
12. VERIFY ROLLBACK READINESS
==================================================

Record:

- Current stable SHA
- Previous stable SHA
- API rollback deployment
- Worker rollback deployment
- Database compatibility
- Rollback command or approved action

Do not perform a destructive rollback unless required.

Prove the rollback path is available and documented.

==================================================
13. REMOVE RORK FROM THE DEPLOYMENT CHAIN
==================================================

Final runtime chain must be:

IVX OWNER DASHBOARD
→ IVX AUTHORIZATION API
→ IVX AUTONOMOUS WORKER
→ IVX GITHUB REPOSITORY
→ IVX GITHUB ACTIONS
→ IVX RENDER SERVICES
→ IVX HEALTH/VERSION CHECK
→ IVX PROOF LEDGER

Rork must not be required for:

- Owner approval
- Job queue
- AI planning
- Code checkout
- Testing
- Build
- Commit
- Push
- Render deployment
- Health verification
- Rollback
- Proof reporting

The Rork chat may only be an optional development interface, not part of production execution.

==================================================
FINAL REQUIRED EVIDENCE
==================================================

OWNER AUTHORIZATION
- Owner session valid:
- Authorization ID:
- Action:
- Approved SHA:
- Worker ID:
- Issued:
- Expires:
- Hash-only storage:
- Consumed:

AUTONOMOUS JOB
- Job ID:
- Worker ID:
- Initial status:
- Final status:
- Started:
- Completed:
- Proof ledger ID:

GITHUB
- Repository:
- Owner:
- Branch:
- GitHub HEAD SHA:
- GitHub Actions run ID:
- Workflow result:

RENDER API
- Service ID:
- Deployment ID:
- Live SHA:
- Status:
- Boot time:

RENDER WORKER
- Service ID:
- Deployment ID:
- Live SHA:
- Status:
- Heartbeat:
- Last completed job:

WEBSITE
- Deployment ID:
- URL:
- HTTP status:
- Live version:

LIVE VERIFICATION
- /health:
- /version:
- Public chat:
- Unauthorized owner request:
- Valid owner request:
- Worker status:

SECURITY
- Replay rejected:
- Duplicate job:
- Duplicate deployment:
- Secret scan:
- Rork dependency guard:

ROLLBACK
- Current stable SHA:
- Previous stable SHA:
- Rollback available:
- Recovery verified:

==================================================
FINAL PASS CONDITIONS
==================================================

Mark AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT = PASS only when:

- Owner authorizes from IVX.
- Worker receives a short-lived single-use authorization.
- Worker checks out the IVX repository.
- Tests pass.
- Builds pass.
- Exact approved SHA is deployed.
- GitHub HEAD matches live API and worker SHAs.
- /health returns HTTP 200.
- /version returns the live SHA.
- Public chat works.
- Worker completes the job.
- Proof ledger is written.
- Replay is rejected.
- No duplicate deployment occurs.
- Worker restart does not repeat the job.
- Rollback path is available.
- Rork is not required anywhere in the production deployment chain.

FINAL STATUS:

AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

RORK REQUIRED FOR DEPLOYMENT:
YES / NO

IVX INDEPENDENT DEPLOYMENT:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

Do not return another architecture proposal.
Execute the full chain and provide live proof.
